$comment: Exceptions to the cache's own answer, applied by AnimationStalls.plugin.js. Core measures every swing from its seq config (NpcAnimationScanner.getSequenceStall), so a weapon whose animation already withholds steps needs no row here - hunters' crossbows (seq 4230) and the polearm, salamander, chinchompa, obby-ring, banner, partisan and bulwark styles all do. Rows override the measured value by animation id or by equipped weapon id: kind none|partial|full, ticks (omit to keep the cache's length), holdsHits. Cite the source for every row.

20727.source: Wiki: Animation stall - Attack animation stalls. Its battleaxe seqs (395, 401) carry masks, so the client does not withhold steps for them and the cache alone rates the swing a partial stall.
